name: B，层级引导目录树
units: Qt logical pixels / CSS pixels in the normalized 1024-wide main window
coordinate_note: 图板是放大的视觉说明，不存在适用于三张图板的共同缩放系数；下列值是组件落地尺寸，不是对图片像素的测量。切片的 source physical rect 单独记入资产清单。

responsive_rules.glyph_slots: disclosure = 14.4 * font_scale; folder = 16 * font_scale; branch marker uses a 19.2 canvas; hit area grows with accessibility font_scale
responsive_rules.indentation: 12.8 logical pixels at every accessibility font scale; content scrolls when the depth does not fit
responsive_rules.tooltip: No floating tooltip on hover. Full archive path remains available in accessible descriptions and details.
responsive_rules.scrollbars: inside the directory viewport; visible only when content overflows; never around the application frame
responsive_rules.labels: Measure only expanded visible rows, allow horizontal scroll for full names; no reserved count column; 16 logical pixels trailing inset

rendering.folder: shared folder SVG/PNG; aspect-preserving inside a 16-unit slot
rendering.disclosure: shared chevron-right/chevron-down SVG/PNG; visible only with child directories
rendering.guides: Native one-unit lines; line centers share the parent disclosure center X, including font-scale growth. Stop at last sibling center.
rendering.current: native selection background plus 2.4-unit leading indicator
rendering.focus: Full-height leading indicator with square left corners; no four-sided outline
rendering.hidden_current: shared tree-active-branch glyph on a 19.2-unit canvas at the nearest visible collapsed ancestor
rendering.text: live, escaped plain text using platform fonts; never baked into an icon
rendering.loading: shared tree-spinner segmented glyph; rotation is driven by the live component and disabled under reduced motion
rendering.information: shared tree-info solid neutral circle with white information mark
rendering.error: shared tree-warning filled amber rounded triangle with white exclamation

event_rules.disclosure_click: toggle expansion only; preserve directory query and file selection
event_rules.label_click: activate directory through its current-session node ID
event_rules.up_down: move focus among visible rows; do not activate
event_rules.right: expand a collapsed parent; otherwise focus its first child
event_rules.left: collapse an expanded parent; otherwise focus its parent
event_rules.collapse_current_ancestor: preserve current directory and file list; move hidden focus to nearest visible ancestor
event_rules.query_replace: successful directory activation resets page, file selection and details per readonly-browser contract
event_rules.new_session: discard expansion, focus, current node IDs and branch markers from the previous session

integration.html: Recursive example tree, guide lines, full labels without visual counts, disclosure, current/focus separation, collapsed-current marker and directory context menu
integration.qt: Complete real read-only index, guide roles, full labels without visual counts, disclosure, keyboard navigation, collapsed-current marker and directory context menu
remaining: Boundary notice glyphs and skeleton are design resources; no new loading skeleton or error-card consumer
Full dark component board and manual native screen-reader/HiDPI review remain pending

coordinate_mapping.qt: Use geometry values directly as logical pixels
coordinate_mapping.html_source_canvas: source CSS pixels = logical value / XDZIP_DISPLAY_SPEC.sourceToLogical
coordinate_mapping.review_zoom: Apply outside this coordinate conversion; never change source geometry to cancel preview zoom
coordinate_mapping.device_pixel_ratio: DPR selects raster density and stroke snapping; it does not determine logical size

presentation.legacy_geometry_note: count geometry fields remain for historical boards and generated compatibility; current rows have no count consumer

listing.search_scope: recursive physical entries in current directory
listing.implicit_directory: navigation identity only; unknown sizes and dates; cannot enter physical-record preflight
